scripts.build:app: tauri build --no-bundle && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'), name='mini-mindmap'+(process.platform==='win32'?'.exe':''), target='build/'+name; fs.mkdirSync('build',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/target/release/'+name,target+'.tmp'); fs.renameSync(target+'.tmp',target); console.log('Built application at: '+target)"
scripts.test:all: npm test && cargo test --offline --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && npm run test:ui && npm run test:stress
scripts.test:perf-ui: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_perf_ui.py && npm run build && python3 tests/perf_ui.py
